children: Catcher Predict monitoring showed that the "Yes" option for the "84,000" submarket in Polymarket's "Bitcoin breaks out on September 26" event fell sharply from 56.5% one hour earlier to 35%, a drop of 21.5 percentage points. According to ChainCatcher, the move reflects a sudden swing in the prediction market tied to breaking news.

title: Polymarket Bitcoin September 26 Breakout Bet Sees Sharp Swing in 84,000 Yes Odds
